description: Defines the interface for URLRequestContextGetter, a class responsible for retrieving and managing URLRequestContext objects within the Chromium networking code. Includes methods for obtaining the context, managing shutdown notifications, and observer management.

classes.name: URLRequestContextGetter
classes.description: Interface class for retrieving URLRequestContext, managing its lifecycle, and handling shutdown notifications.

classes.name: URLRequestContextGetterTraits
classes.description: Traits struct for custom destruction of URLRequestContextGetter instances.

methods.name: GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the associated URLRequestContext; must be called on the network thread.

methods.name: GetNetworkTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner for the network thread where URL requests are processed.

methods.name: NotifyContextShuttingDown
methods.description: Signals that the URLRequestContext is about to shut down, prompting observers to abort requests.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to monitor for context shutdown events.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from monitoring context shutdown events.

methods.name: OnDestruct
methods.description: Ensures proper deletion of the object on the correct thread.
